description: Change a work item: status (in_progress to start and claim it, review, blocked, completed), priority, title, milestone, assignee, owner_role. Add a note to explain the change. Blocking requires blocked_reason. Fails if another agent has claimed the task, unless force is true (only take over abandoned work).

artifact_id.description: Commit SHA, PR URL, file path…

fields.description: Custom task fields by key (the project lists them in inventor_context → project.customization.fields); null clears one

force.description: Take over a task another agent claimed

id.description: Work item id (UUID or its first 8 characters)

note.description: Comment recorded with the change (what was done / verified)

name: inventor_update_task
